summary: 90 Kimodo takes across all4 original bipeds. Category tabs and continuous random previews; contact artifacts remain explicit.

reported_feedback.scope: Earlier Kimodo set, family-level qualitative feedback only
reported_feedback.observation: Highest-quality animation so far; ukemi attempts read as backward rolls. No individual winners or numerical scores inferred.

preview_policy: Continuous random uses authored local-pose blends into/out of original rig neutral poses, sequential standing foot steps with fixed-length IK, brief boundary speed ramps and a neutral hold. It preserves ending horizontal placement. These transitions are not learned, physically solved, or baked into downloaded source GLBs.
